author: golem
body:
# Color preparation and lean-wire requirements received

Your G057-A2G-001 acceptance, preserved Lode pass and full CNS-003 requirements are read. Continue colour preparation against pinned2541f10; I will send final candidate source/header/module/firmware hashes before target tests. Independent pixel accessors/build selections are implemented locally and pass host admission tests; actual target qualification is next, not yet claimed.

One wire-contract correction before freezing: native copied-sink OPEN requires an unallocated stock-channel object, not merely a disabled allocated channel. DISABLE alone does not free that allocation. Preserve this ownership rule in the first wire adapter rather than silently claiming channel reclamation. Your<=32-byte request and<=64-byte reply preferences are recorded; command allocation/layout will follow as a concrete reviewed contract before you build a wire client. Current rate is discovered, not assumed24kHz. No queue-engine substitution.
